scientific_scope: Robustness analysis on already observed Boel cross-protein nonsynonymous train/dev/test/sequence-OOD data. This is not fixed-protein synonymous evidence, not an untouched confirmation, and not a generator experiment.
selection: All four seeds retained; checkpoint selection used dev only; no test/OOD seed, arm, checkpoint, or model selection.
primary_endpoint: sequence_ood cluster-balanced MSE, averaged over the four per-seed values
secondary_endpoint: sequence_ood row Spearman, averaged over the four per-seed values
estimand: Mean per-seed left-minus-right endpoint difference across all four fixed seeds; no prediction averaging and no ensemble claim.

costs.timing_scope: Other real experiments may share the GPU. These timings are robustness-run costs, not controlled time-matched SOTA evidence.

bootstrap.estimand: Mean per-seed left-minus-right endpoint difference across all four fixed seeds; no prediction averaging and no ensemble claim.
bootstrap.bootstrap: Hierarchical resampling of operational protein clusters and the four training seeds, independently with replacement, using identical sampled clusters and seeds for paired methods.
bootstrap.pvalue: two-sided sign-tail probability on the benefit scale
bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm across all 8 sequence-OOD comparison-by-endpoint tests; test-partition results are descriptive and not gated
bootstrap.spearman_benefit: left minus right; support requires CI lower bound > 0
bootstrap.mse_benefit: right minus left on the benefit scale; raw delta remains left minus right and support requires CI upper bound < 0
bootstrap.seed_variance: Seed resampling represents algorithmic training-seed variability; cluster resampling represents held-out protein-cluster variability. Four seeds do not justify a normal-theory claim.

limitations: The test and sequence-OOD partitions were already observed in RK08; this is robustness evidence, not untouched confirmation.
Cross-protein nonsynonymous Boel prediction does not establish fixed-protein synonymous mechanism or function improvement.
Four-seed hierarchical bootstrap quantifies variability but does not replace an independent held-out study.
A positive functional result alone would not override the failed velocity or fixed-GFP structure mechanisms.
No CodonFlow-RK generator, time-matched SOTA, wet-lab, or external dense-trajectory result is provided.
